business_problem: Applied artificial intelligence (AI) company Instabase Inc . is on the leading edge of generative AI (GenAI) and serves multiple top 10 global banks and other large enterprises such as Axa and Sonic Automotive.
solution_summary: Applied artificial intelligence (AI) company Instabase Inc . is on the leading edge of generative AI (GenAI) and serves multiple top 10 global banks and other large enterprises such as Axa and Sonic Automotive. Learn how Instabase in the software and internet industry built AI Hub, a generative AI solution based on large language models, using AWS. Key services included Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service runs containerized services and scales application workloads across clusters; Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud provides scalable compute capacity for application services or ai workloads; Amazon S3 stores documents, media, telemetry, or training data durably at scale; Amazon OpenSearch Service stores and retrieves indexed or vectorized content for search and rag workflows. Its launch in June 2023 was only the beginning for AI Hub.
